description: EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Nampula Province, Mozambique, Tropical Cyclone Jude, 13 Mar 2025 is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Earth Observatory of Singapore. The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Damage Proxy Map (DPM) depicting areas that are likely damaged in the Nampula Province, Mozambique, due to Tropical Cyclone Jude. Coverage: Mozambique. The portal files it under the publisher Earth Observatory of Singapore. Its tags are FOS: Earth and related environmental sciences. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
